description: The line plot titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny" illustrates the performance of different configurations of the Whisper model over a series of epochs, measured by the Word Error Rate (WER). The x-axis, labeled "epoch," is linear and ranges from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled "WER," is also linear and ranges from approximately 25 to 70, with tick labels at regular intervals. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration of the Whisper model: tiny AdaLoRA_int4, tiny AdaLoRA_int8, tiny int4, tiny int8, and tiny. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line is solid with circle markers, the tiny AdaLoRA_int8 line is dashed with square markers, the tiny int4 line is dotted with circle markers, the tiny int8 line is dash-dot with square markers, and the tiny line is a solid line with triangle markers. All lines show a general downward trend, indicating an improvement in WER as the number of epochs increases. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line starts at the highest WER value and ends at the lowest, while the other lines start and end at lower WER values. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of changes in WER.
